tū

tū, tuī

pronoun, second person: dative tibi, accusative and ablative tē; plural vōs · Wiktionary

you (one person)

In this lexicon

  • you

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Curc. 516–516d: Heus tū, tibi ego dīcō.; Ter. Ph. 556: ūnā tēcum bona mala tolerābimus; Traupman 100: heus tū, tibi ego dīcō!; Traupman 410

  • Nōn tū tenēs?: do you get it?

    classical

  • Haec tū tēcum habētō.: keep it to yourself

    classical

  • Quid tū es tam trīstis?: why so sad?

    classical

  • nunc tū: your turn

    * our formation

Examples

  • Quō nunc abīs? quīn tū hīc manēs?
